description: Program.cs DI wiring, appsettings files, and EF Core migration. Wires together every component from FEAT-001 through FEAT-003 into a runnable application. Depends on all previous FEATs. The app must build and start (dotnet run) after this FEAT.
steps:
2. Overwrite DCDSS/appsettings.json with the exact JSON from design Section 11 (no usable secrets committed):
    {
      "ConnectionStrings": { "DefaultConnection": "Server=localhost;Port=3306;Database=dcdss;User=root;Password=changeme;AllowPublicKeyRetrieval=True;" },
      "JwtSettings": { "Issuer": "DCDSS", "Audience": "DCDSS", "SigningKey": "REPLACE_ME", "ExpiryMinutes": 60 },
      "CorsSettings": { "AllowedOrigins": "https://localhost:3000" },
      "AdminSeed": { "Username": "admin", "Password": "", "FullName": "System Administrator", "Email": "admin@dcdss.local", "Department": null },
      "Logging": { "LogLevel": { "Default": "Information", "Microsoft.AspNetCore": "Warning" } },
      "AllowedHosts": "*"
    }

4. Attempt EF Core migration. Run inside 'c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\DCDSS' (the project folder). First try: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef --version 8.0.33 then dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate. If the tool install fails or dotnet ef is unavailable, document in findings and skip migration (the build step is the acceptance gate; migration requires a live DB for database update but NOT for migrations add with an explicit server version). IMPORTANT: The design uses AddDbContextFactory with MySqlServerVersion(8,0,34) explicitly, so migrations add should work without a live DB. Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development before running dotnet ef so the dev appsettings (with valid SigningKey) is used, avoiding the JwtSettingsValidator fail-fast on startup.
acceptance_criteria: Program.cs registers all 8 repo scoped registrations, generic IRepository<> scoped, IUnitOfWork scoped, all 11 scoped services, 3 singleton services, ICurrentUserService scoped, PasswordHasher<User> transient.
GlobalExceptionMiddleware is registered FIRST (before UseHttpsRedirection, UseCors, UseAuthentication).
IAdminSeeder.SeedAsync() is called after app.Build() and before app.Run().
appsettings.json has SigningKey='REPLACE_ME' (rejected by validator — app will not start without override).
dotnet build produces 0 errors after this FEAT.
If migration was created: Migrations/ folder contains the three generated files.
verification: dotnet build "c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\DCDSS.sln" — must produce Build succeeded with 0 Error(s) 0 Warning(s).
If migration was attempted: confirm DCDSS/Migrations/ contains InitialCreate.cs, InitialCreate.Designer.cs, DcdssContextModelSnapshot.cs.
findings: Program.cs fully rewritten with all required DI registrations, middleware pipeline, CORS named policy 'Default', health checks (/health), Swagger with JWT security definition, AdminSeeder called after app.Build(), JwtSettingsValidator via AddSingleton + AddOptions ValidateOnStart, GlobalExceptionMiddleware registered FIRST, AddAuthentication before AddAuthorization, FallbackPolicy=RequireAuthenticatedUser, AddDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> with MySqlServerVersion(8,0,34). AddDbContextCheck<DcdssContext> required adding package Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.33 (not previously in csproj). appsettings.json overwritten with full config (SigningKey=REPLACE_ME). appsettings.Development.json overwritten with dev overrides (SigningKey=DevOnlySigningKey_32bytes_minimum_DO_NOT_USE_IN_PROD, AdminSeed:Password=Admin@12345, EF log level=Information). EF Core migration: dotnet-ef 8.0.33 installed globally; migration add InitialCreate succeeded (ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development). Migration files generated: 20261102232530_InitialCreate.cs, 20261102232530_InitialCreate.Designer.cs, DcdssContextModelSnapshot.cs. Build: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
